item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We must act now to prevent its development—not wait until systems beyond human control already exist.

2. We cannot control something vastly more intelligent than every human institution combined. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years would permanently surrender humanity’s power to shape what comes next.

3. The race to build superintelligent AI is not progress. It is a race toward permanently losing control of humanity’s future. We must stop its development before that loss becomes irreversible.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. A system more capable than any person, government, or institution would not remain meaningfully subject to human direction. Once created, it could shape economies, security, information, infrastructure, and political power on terms we could no longer determine. This is not a challenge we can solve after deployment or contain through minor safeguards. The decisive moment is now, while humanity still has the power to choose. We must prevent the development of superintelligent AI and establish binding limits before the race to build it crosses a threshold from which there is no return.
